protocol.trajectory: Unmodified A9 vs A9, seat-swapped initial hands and turn selector, same remaining deck and dice; no candidate enters actual game
protocol.hypothesis: Actual concealed sets contain a larger fraction of rank<=7 cards than the uniform unseen-pool forecast; threshold fixed from existing concealment policy, not fitted
protocol.primary: Actual concealed low-card fraction minus known-card-adjusted unseen low fraction; average within game, seats, then deals. Selection mean >0; confirmation lower normal95 >0 and all pairs represented supports positive calibration bias.
protocol.eligibility: Comparison actor only before every move, opponent at least one concealed board card; missing games make pair incomplete, no replacement.
protocol.scope: Exact hypergeometric uniform forecast from own known cards and public opponent board only; real hidden identities used only as labels. Diagnostic of a specified marginal, not full-set calibration, opponent posterior, win rate or adoption.
